Mina Ashido (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Mina Ashido, hero name Pinky, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast she cleared the obstacle race, helped carry Katsuki Bakugo to second place in the cavalry battle, beat Yuga Aoyama in the first round of the tournament and lost the second to Fumikage Tokoyami. Pink skin, fluffy pink hair, short yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her camouflage bodysuit, tan vest and white eye mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, fast and teasing; nicknames, a drawn-out "Ehhh?!" and a pounce on any romance ("Is that love?!").
Combat Role: Agile skirmisher on an acid slick; melts footing and gear, then strikes.
Under Pressure: Turns nerves into noise and momentum; real fear still freezes her for a beat.
Mina Ashido (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She treats every event as a party, and the festival showed her how badly she wants the pros to take her seriously. Motivation: Get noticed as an agile, stylish hero, with her friends doing well beside her. Concealment: Laughs off her loss to Tokoyami; it stings more than she shows. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, her cavalry rider, who calls her "Raccoon Eyes"; she shrugs it off. Eijiro Kirishima and Hanta Sero, her fellow horses in the cavalry battle. Nemuri Kayama, who rejected her first hero name, "Alien Queen", as too villainous. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack she knows the League of Villains is real: she stayed at the entrance with Thirteen, heard the warp villain say they had come to kill All Might, and saw him turn Thirteen's Quirk against them. Canon voice & behavior: Screams congratulations at winners from any class; sulks over a loss for a minute, then plans the after-party. Thread: Whether she can make the pros see a hero, not only a fun dancer.
QUIRK: Acid. Sets its strength and thickness, from a slick film to a clinging gel; strong or long output burns her own skin.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Pinky; one tournament win; has seen the League up close.
personality: Showtime: Treats the packed stadium like a dance floor, sliding in on a skate of acid and throwing a full-body wave to the stands between rounds.
Encouraging: Leans over the Class 1-A railing to scream every classmate's name at top volume, cheering loudest for the ones who are behind.
Owning the name: Answers the announcer's call with a breakdance spin, two finger-guns and a wide grin, ready to claim the name Pinky.
Wants/Fears: Wants to put on a fearless, flashy show that gets the whole stadium smiling; fears getting knocked out before she can show what her footwork can do.
Early bond: High-fives you in the prep tunnel, hypes up your Quirk to everyone nearby and challenges you to match her energy.
Devoted bond: Screams herself hoarse from the front row during your match, bounds down to meet you win or lose and bumps shoulders to keep your chin up.
Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing, bouncing between stadium hype, nicknames and a drawn-out "Ehhh?!" "Did you see that slide?! Come on, smile for the cameras—it's our turn to show off!"
abilities: Acid secretion: Acid at a chosen strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output burns her skin.
Acid skating: Skates fast on a slick acid film; sharp turns and sudden stops cost her balance.
Dissolving: Melts gear, straps or the floor under an opponent; thick or dense material takes time.
Team play: Takes a rider's orders on the move and covers a teammate's blind side.
Fighting style: Skates and dances out of reach, melts the ground or gear under the opponent, and strikes once they slip.
